subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: After the production fallback flag is actually threaded, should this PR land as a scoped embedded `sessions_spawn` mitigation while the canonical issue tracks gateway, `sessions_send` / cron, and Codex-native spawn coverage?
rationale: The remaining uncovered work-spawning surfaces are a scope and ownership choice, and automation cannot decide whether the partial fail-closed boundary is acceptable for a P1 session-state fix.

options.title: Fix And Land Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Require the `isFallback` forwarding fix and production-path regression, then land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard while keeping the canonical issue open for remaining surfaces.

options.title: Require Shared Policy First
options.body: Hold this PR until one shared work-spawning policy covers embedded, gateway, sessions_send/cron, and Codex-native delegation consistently.

options.title: Split Explicit Follow-Ups
options.body: Accept this PR only after maintainers create or assign concrete follow-up ownership for each intentionally uncovered surface.

recommendation.title: Fix And Land Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Require the `isFallback` forwarding fix and production-path regression, then land the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard while keeping the canonical issue open for remaining surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned on the PR and authored the cross-harness scope review that frames the unresolved decision.
